main.description: A composition of templates (sequence, tree, or other structure). Used for multi-part stimuli, template hierarchies, and complex item construction.

compositionTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the composition type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

compositionType.description: Composition type slug (fallback when compositionTypeUri unavailable).

experimentRef.description: Reference to the experiment this composition was designed for.

metadata.description: Provenance: who assembled this composition, with what tool.

features.description: Open-ended features describing this composition not captured by the typed fields.

createdAt.description: When this composition record was created.
